faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

questions.shippingTimeAnswer: Standard shipping takes 2-7 business days. Express shipping (1-3 days) is available for select items. Free shipping is included on orders over $500.
questions.returnPolicyAnswer: We offer a 30-day return window for all products. Items must be in original condition. Mattresses have a 100-night trial period. Return shipping is free.
questions.whiteGloveAnswer: Yes! White-glove delivery includes room-of-choice placement, assembly, and removal of packaging materials. Available in select areas for an additional fee.
questions.warrantyOfferAnswer: All mattresses come with a 10-20 year warranty depending on the model. Furniture includes a 3-5 year warranty. Full warranty details are provided with each product.
questions.tryBeforeBuy: Can I try a mattress before buying?
questions.tryBeforeBuyAnswer: Yes! We offer a 100-night risk-free trial. If you're not satisfied, we'll arrange a free pickup and full refund.
questions.internationalShippingAnswer: Currently, we ship within the United States and Canada. International shipping may be available for select items - please contact us for details.
questions.paymentMethods: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.paymentMethodsAnswer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and buy-now-pay-later options through Klarna and Afterpay.
questions.warrantyClaim: How do I file a warranty claim?
questions.warrantyClaimAnswer: Contact our customer service team with your order number and a description of the issue. We'll guide you through the warranty claim process.
questions.chooseSize: How do I choose the right mattress size?
questions.chooseSizeAnswer: Use our size guide tool on product pages. Consider your room size, sleeping partner, and personal space preferences. Our sleep specialists can also help you choose.
questions.damagedProduct: What if my product arrives damaged?
questions.damagedProductAnswer: Contact us immediately with photos of the damage. We'll arrange a replacement or full refund at no cost to you, including free return shipping.
